title: dclabai: the open-source edition of the studio, exported from the private repository
request: Make an open-source project out of the studio without leaking the source of what stays private: anyone can install it with pip, npx or Docker and run it with their own model (Ollama, any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, Claude) or none. Open core, Apache-2.0, name dclabai (dclab is taken on PyPI).
spec: Plan async-skipping-firefly: one source and two trees; seams in the private code instead of surgery on copies; an export script with an allowlist manifest, a rename, closed blocks, a leak scanner, an import closure and a UI build; bring-your-own-model with init/doctor; leak-proofing gates; packaging (wheel, npm launcher, Docker, CI); a fresh-install test; a fresh-eyes leak audit.
plan: seams: extensions.optional(), gates.py, lazy contracts, default workspace outside site-packages
export: manifest, forbidden words, overlay, import closure, UI build, knowledge subset, test selection
the dclab command (start, init, doctor, models trust/status, migrate, users, worker, version), neutral model defaults
fresh-install proof: pip install in a clean Python 3.12, dclab start, the product flows with no model and with fake and real models
leak audit by an independent agent, then remove every finding for real
publish on the owner's account and fix what its CI finds

decisions.decision: Closed parts are cut by optional() seams and `dclab:closed` comment blocks in the private source, never by editing exported copies
decisions.why: one source of truth: the private edition runs unchanged, and the export cannot drift from it

decisions.decision: A private table is removed, never renamed: its name and columns are forbidden words, every mention a blocking finding
decisions.why: the audit showed a rename (HyperAck to RideFare) hid only the name while its schema, counts, dates and scores still shipped

decisions.decision: The open edition starts tool-using agents on their rules until dclab doctor's probe passes or the person trusts the model
decisions.why: the full edition's sealed measurements are not shipped; a model that writes calls as text must never reach the person

decisions.decision: pandas is capped below 3 in the open package; the port is a separate task
decisions.why: a fresh install picked pandas 3 and the engine broke (copy-on-write, a string dtype); the private environment is on 2.3

decisions.decision: The model settings file lives in ~/.config/dclabai, outside the workspace
decisions.why: the workspace folder is backed up whole; a key inside it would travel with every backup

decisions.decision: Commits on the public repository use the owner's GitHub no-reply address
decisions.why: the personal e-mail would otherwise be public in the history

change: A new export pipeline (scripts/export_open.py, export/manifest.py, export/forbidden.txt, export/overlay/) builds dclabai from the private repository; seams across dclab_rnd and dclab_core keep closed parts out without changing the full edition; dclab_rnd/open_cli.py is the dclab command; fixes in the product found on the way (listed as findings).

findings.defect: dclab_core imported importlib for its seams, which its boundary test forbids
findings.fix: plain imports inside try/except ModuleNotFoundError; the twin board a closed block

findings.defect: a store keeper wrote the workspace marker into the folder it keeps, so a second run was never all unchanged
findings.cause: db.workspace_for creates the marker on first use
findings.fix: workspace_key(mark=False) for readers; the walk keeper opens the PostgreSQL stores itself

findings.defect: /api/config of the open server sent the research campaign's projects, commands and a vendor model
findings.scenario: a fresh install, empty HOME, GET /api/config
findings.cause: the config route always added the campaign's fields
findings.fix: the fields only where agentic.campaign_tools exists

findings.cause: copy-on-write and the new string dtype
findings.fix: the open package caps pandas below 3; the port is a task

findings.defect: dclab_core.forecast failed on scikit-learn 1.9 when a gap empties a lag column
findings.cause: HistGradientBoosting cannot bin a column with no value
findings.fix: drop all-empty columns before the fit (identical results on 1.7)

findings.defect: an unshipped repository sample answered 500 from the project route, the intern's tool and MCP
findings.scenario: POST /api/projects/{id}/data/sample with a table not in the tree
findings.fix: refuse it like an unknown key, as the catalog already hid it

findings.defect: downloads went inside site-packages for an installed package
findings.scenario: use a download-on-first-use sample from an installed package
findings.fix: the workspace's downloads folder unless running from a checkout

findings.defect: pages called client functions whose routes the open edition lacks; Domain packs did not render
findings.scenario: open the Domain packs page in the open edition
findings.cause: a missing function threw a TypeError before the page could catch it
findings.fix: the generated client answers a missing route with a rejected 404 promise; closed panes, loaders and nav entries are closed blocks

findings.defect: a refused notebook cell plus a failing model wrote the cell twice
findings.scenario: the model writes a cell that is refused, then its next request fails
findings.cause: the fallback counted only non-failed tasks as work done
findings.fix: back to any task or card; the refused-call path clears its own tasks

findings.defect: a passed probe outlived the model it tested
findings.scenario: model A passes doctor, model B fails it, B still serves
findings.cause: the probe kept neither the model nor failures
findings.fix: the probe carries model and endpoint and every outcome is recorded

findings.defect: dclab init wrote API keys into the default workspace, so backups carried them
findings.scenario: dclab init, then a workspace backup
findings.cause: ~/.dclabai was both the config and the workspace

findings.defect: a tier on another server inherited OpenAI's model name
findings.scenario: a cheap tier on Ollama with no model named
findings.cause: the tier copied the standard model
findings.fix: that server's own default, none unless OpenAI's

findings.defect: the leak audit found the private delivery table, a confidential challenge's brief, the retail interview and the main product's internals in the export
findings.scenario: an independent agent read the exported tree
findings.fix: forbidden words with closed blocks, exclusions and invented rewrites; knowledge records naming private data dropped

findings.defect: with a small local model (qwen2.5-coder:1.5b) trusted, the person saw tool calls written as text and one-word replies
findings.scenario: the built chat with that model on Ollama
findings.cause: only refused calls handed the turn to the rules
findings.fix: a written call or a reply under three words, when nothing ran, goes to the rules

findings.defect: the first public CI run failed: macOS lacked OpenMP, doctor failed a plain install, database tests raced, a test needed a sample table
findings.cause: the open runner ran database tests in parallel on one database; the notebook extra counted as required
findings.fix: libomp in CI and the README, the notebook a note, database tests serial, the test left out
findings.test: public CI third run: all jobs passed

measurements.name: export check
measurements.gate: 0 findings from the forbidden words, the secret scan, the import closure and the UI build
measurements.result: 0 findings; 633 files; 30 knowledge records; 97 test files

measurements.name: fresh-install product flows
measurements.gate: the five flows of scripts/product_e2e.py pass on the installed package
measurements.result: all pass with no model and with a fake model; the team flow skipped by design

measurements.name: public CI
measurements.gate: every job of the open repository's CI passes
measurements.result: third run: tests on Python 3.10-3.13 and macOS, flows, package, secret scan all passed

measurements.name: harness and agent suites after the tool-text change
measurements.gate: 17 of 17 harness cases right on every step

outcome: dclabai is public at github.com/Shahriyar-Moradi/dclabai: installable from the repository, runs with no model or a local or hosted one, its CI green; the private edition is unchanged in behaviour. Left: the PyPI and npm names (the owner's), a first release, the pandas 3 port.
lessons: A rename hides a name, not data: forbid the words and remove the content.
A fake model proves the plumbing; only a real small model showed the person seeing written tool calls.
Test a fresh install early: version caps, macOS libraries and file locations break there, not in the developer's environment.
Run the selection of tests on what the open tree holds (closed blocks stripped), or the selection lies.
risks: a private word that is not on the list
a feature that silently differs between editions
